title: Design System: LMCT+ Petrol South Australia

display.purpose: Two-line hero statements and verified oversized campaign claims only.

headline.purpose: Full-width chapter headings and major proof transitions.

title.purpose: Plain-language labels inside rate, proof and disclosure patterns.

body.purpose: Readable offer mechanics, support copy and terms.

label.purpose: Uppercase italic button copy and compact high-emphasis actions.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Short transform feedback, proof cues and the station-image reveal.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Reserved for deliberate two-state movement when symmetric acceleration is needed.

motion.name: button-press
motion.purpose: Two-pixel hover lift and 0.97 active press scale.

motion.name: proof-cue
motion.purpose: Single-run, content-specific proof transforms on intersection.

motion.name: image-reveal
motion.purpose: One shutter reveal and settle for the Edwardstown hero image.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Near-instant parity for animation and transition when reduced motion is requested.

narrative.overview:
LMCT+ Petrol South Australia feels like a bold annual-offer campaign printed at forecourt scale and translated into a precise digital ledger. Large condensed type, real Edwardstown imagery and decisive navy, white and electric-blue fields make the practical fuel proposition instantly legible; exact renewal, purchase and promotion terms keep that confidence credible.

The system is editorial rather than app-dashboard-like. Full-width colour chapters alternate with asymmetric splits, price and entry figures act as typographic anchors, and only the few concepts that benefit from enclosure become panels. It rejects generic card grids, decorative prize collages, unverified countdown theatre and imagery that implies benefits the offer does not include.
keyCharacteristics: Alternating full-width navy, white, blue-white and campaign-blue editorial fields.
Bold italic uppercase Barlow Semi Condensed headlines paired with highly readable Jost copy.
One-plan price ledgers, oversized factual numerals and concise Australian-English disclosures.
Real Edwardstown station and LMCT+ app imagery used as evidence, with captions that limit what each image claims.
Restrained transform-only motion, visible focus states and reduced-motion parity.

rules.name: The Electric Destination Rule
rules.body: Campaign blue marks a small number of high-value destinations or proof points; it does not wash every section.

rules.name: The Full-Ink Rule
rules.body: Primary body copy uses Ink on light surfaces. Muted and cool-tint copy is limited to notes, captions and disclosures.

rules.name: The Two-Line Rule
rules.body: Display and headline copy must remain short enough to resolve in no more than two lines at its intended breakpoint.

rules.name: The Numeral-as-Evidence Rule
rules.body: Price, litres, spend thresholds and prize amounts may become oversized typography only when they state a verified campaign fact.

rules.name: The Alternating Field Rule
rules.body: Build rhythm through large navy, white, blue-white and campaign-blue chapters; do not turn the page into a procession of same-size cards.

rules.name: The One-Plan Rule
rules.body: A single annual offer is expressed as one price ledger and one final close, never as a comparison table or invented tier system.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Do not add floating-card shadows, glows or glass effects. Separate surfaces with colour, whitespace and restrained borders only when a real boundary is needed.

rules.name: The Restrained Radius Rule
rules.body: Sixteen pixels is the maximum standard panel radius. Pills belong to actions and meters, not to every container.

dos: **Do** use real Edwardstown station and LMCT+ app imagery as evidence, with honest captions that define what the image does and does not prove.
**Do** keep price, annual renewal, 12-month duration, Edwardstown location and fuel-purchased-separately terms next to the relevant action.
**Do** alternate full-width editorial fields and preserve asymmetric desktop compositions before collapsing cleanly at 820px.
**Do** limit motion to short transform feedback, one purposeful image reveal and content-specific proof cues, with a complete reduced-motion fallback.
**Do** keep campaign facts and integrations in the single campaign configuration object so dates, rates, URLs, selectors and assets remain updateable without rewriting the page.
**Do** scope every fragment selector and design token under `.lmct-sa-fuel-million`.
donts: **Don't** invent offer tiers, entry quantities, fuel prices, fixed savings, partner benefits, testimonials or countdown precision that has not been confirmed.
**Don't** imply that pictured app prices, savings, rewards or unrelated promotions are package inclusions.
**Don't** use generic giveaway collages, unrelated footage, decorative video or prize imagery in place of real location and product proof.
**Don't** repeat identical floating cards, add ambient shadows or exceed the restrained 16px standard panel radius.
**Don't** use blanket fades, delayed reading, layout-property animation or motion that survives `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.
**Don't** let the mobile sticky action cover the slider, FAQ controls, headings, final offer, checkout or footer.
